items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Six boys. We used to sing on the fire.

ctx.x: Or guitar. Yeah. Oh, my way we used to have a quartet.
Six boys. We used to sing on the fire. It sounds so good on the river. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm.
